content: Today was a busy day, but I managed to get through it. My computer programming class went well, and I turned in my homework on time. Basketball practice was tough, and my elbow was bothering me the whole time. I need to make sure to take care of it so it doesn't get worse. I'm looking forward to unwinding with some video games before bed. Overall, I'm feeling good about my progress both on and off the court. Time to rest up for another day of hard work tomorrow.
